cases.question: 销量最高的3个商品是哪些？
cases.oracle_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS q FROM order_items oi
             JOIN products p ON oi.product_id=p.id GROUP BY p.product_name
             ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT ?

cases.question: 普通会员的平均客单价是多少？
cases.oracle_sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.actual_amount),2) FROM orders o
             JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.id
             WHERE c.member_level=? AND o.status='已完成'

cases.question: 用微信支付支付的已完成订单有多少笔？
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE payment_method=? AND status='已完成'

cases.question: 核销率最高的3个活动是哪些？
cases.oracle_sql:
SELECT a.activity_name,
             ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status='已核销' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0/COUNT(c.id),4) AS rate
             FROM coupons c JOIN activities a ON c.activity_id=a.id
             GROUP BY a.activity_name ORDER BY rate DESC LIMIT ?

cases.question: 销售额前5的城市是哪些？
cases.oracle_sql:
SELECT s.city, ROUND(SUM(o.actual_amount),2) AS v FROM orders o
             JOIN stores s ON o.store_id=s.id WHERE o.status='已完成'
             GROUP BY s.city ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 5
